parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/AppServices/Tests/AppServicesTests/ReviewRequestServiceTests.swift`. The two methods — `recordPlaybackStartedIncrementsCount` and `recordRequestSentIncrementsCount` — are distinct test cases that verify different state transitions on `ReviewRequestService`; their structural similarity (Jaccard 0.75) reflects the natural parallel shape of increment-and-assert test bodies, not accidental duplication. Collapsing them into a generic helper would obscure the intent of each individual test scenario and couple unrelated behavioral assertions. The restraint marker `is_test: true` on every record in the cluster dominates any action signal.
